name: Stinger
description:
Detects stingers by analyzing the credits region of each movie with ffmpeg,
cross-checked against TMDB keywords and Wikipedia's post-credits list.
Writes credits media segments so skip-credits lands on the stinger, appends
an overview marker, and can notify clients to stay tuned during playback.
overview: Labels movies with mid- and post-credits scenes (stingers)

- 1.0.4: Overview marker now reads "Stingers: ..." for clarity (existing movies need a force rescan to pick up the new wording)
